about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: AWS DevOps / Platform Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and automating enterprise cloud infrastructure, CI/CD platforms, Infrastructure as Code, and developer tooling.

Hands-on expertise in AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitHub Enterprise, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Bash, Python, and Datadog. Proven track record of automating cloud infrastructure and CI/CD processes, improving developer productivity, optimizing cloud costs, and supporting enterprise engineering platforms.

Architected a hybrid ECR distribution strategy combining Cross-Region Replication and Pull-Through Cache across 7 global AWS regions, reducing multi-region storage and data transfer costs by 90%+ and generating $163,884 in annualized infrastructure savings.
about.quote: Building reliable engineering platforms that empower developers to ship faster.
